title: Missing-Models-Downloads, [Bug] "Download All" button for missing models is unresponsive on Windows, bug: Missing model download buttons do nothing
key_points: Users report that the 'Download All' button for missing models is unresponsive, not starting any downloads or showing progress.
Individual download buttons for each model are also reported as unresponsive.
Missing-model functionality is considered a step backwards compared to previous individual download capability.
limitations: Reports are based on user experiences and observations, not verified by the source itself.
asserts: The 'Download All' button for missing models does not initiate any downloads or show progress.
scope: ComfyUI's missing-model download functionality on Windows operating systems
